data.title: Iran’s hidden web of military agencies is slipping hardware past the US blockade | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: “This is the complete ecosystem of the Iranian military’s trade business," said Miad Maleki, a former senior official at the US Treasury Department who helped design the American sanctions on Iran.
